gate_formula: z=(pre-RMSNorm post-attention residual-mean)/std; raw=z@encoder.T+bias; gate=raw if raw>theta and raw>0 else 0
precision: native BF16; full MOLT FP32 TF32 disabled
native_models: base with disabled adapter versus identical base with medical adapter enabled
input_pairing: identical saved token sequence for both models
cache_policy: Recomputable native activation cache deleted wave by wave only after per-token and per-example reconstruction metrics saved and hashed. Stress activations retained.
